product_name: truke Bass S2 Sleeping Earphone Designed for Side Sleepers with Soft Silicone, 13mm Driver for Clear Audio, Type-C Jack, Noise-Reducing Fit, Lightweight & Durable TPE Wire for All-Night Comfort-Black
description: 🌙 Ultimate Side-Sleeper Comfort: Engineered with an ultra-compact, low-profile design that sits flush in your ear—perfect for side sleepers to enjoy a pain-free, restful night. ☁️ Skin-Friendly Soft Silicone: Crafted from premium, velvet-soft silicone that offers a lightweight, pressure-free fit, making you feel like you aren't wearing earphones at all. 🎵 Balanced 13mm Audio: Powered by 13mm Drivers tuned specifically for sleep, delivering crisp and soothing sound for white noise, relaxing podcasts, or deep-sleep melodies. 🔇 Noise-Reducing Seal: The ergonomic in-ear fit acts as a natural shield, blocking out disruptive ambient sounds like snoring or city traffic for a distraction-free slumber. 🐍 Durable Sleep-Proof Cable: Features a high-quality, tangle-resistant TPE wire that is flexible enough to handle nightly tossing and turning without snapping or tangling.
